diagnosis.headline: Café Athena is already the top-ranked name in a fragmented field (#1 share of voice, but only 2.8% across 262 restaurants), and it wins only generic 'Greek' and dish queries. It is invisible on the 25 queries about dietary needs, happy hour, groups/catering and cocktails/occasions. Its services exist on the homepage, but it has no dedicated crawlable pages, no Restaurant/Menu/FAQ schema, and a third-party footprint (reviews, niche directories, recent lists) 3–8x thinner than competitors.

gaps.gap: Dietary options are claimed but not structured or findable (0% mention rate)
gaps.evidence: Dietary category: 0 of 8 answers mention Café Athena, with 68 restaurants seen. Four lost queries: q03, q09, q10, q22. The site flags gluten_free, vegan and vegetarian as true, but pages_found is only '/' and '/about'. There is no menu page and has_menu_schema is false. findmeglutenfree.com is the #5 cited source (11 citations), and Café Athena's directory list (OpenTable, Toast Local, DoorDash, Postmates, MenuPages) does not include it.
gaps.competitor_example: Meze Greek Fusion wins q03 and is listed on findmeglutenfree and HappyCow, so it appears in the sources AI cites for dietary questions. Callie and Herb & Wood also win q03. Spitz's profile highlights vegan and gluten-free options.
gaps.fix: Publish a crawlable /menu page and a /vegan-vegetarian-gluten-free page that name actual dishes and mark each GF, V or VG. Add Menu/MenuItem schema with suitableForDiet. Add an FAQ ('Does Café Athena have gluten-free Mediterranean options?'). Claim and complete the findmeglutenfree and HappyCow listings.

gaps.gap: Happy hour exists but is not packaged as a specific, citable offer
gaps.evidence: Happy_hour: 1 of 5 answers mention Café Athena, sov_rank 27. Lost queries q04, q11, q12 and q26 are all 100% misses. The site signal 'happy_hour' is true, but there is no /happy-hour page (JRDN has one). The title and meta description mention neither happy hour nor small plates. Café Athena's known_for lists the 3–6 PM happy hour only as a brief mention.
gaps.competitor_example: Costa Brava is #2 in share of voice and wins q04. It is the '#1 Best Tapas in San Diego' (A-List, cited by OpenTable), and its profile highlights a half-price happy hour and an extensive tapas menu. Bar Ella wins q11 and q12, and barellapb.com is a cited source. Spitz is on Yelp's 'Top 10 Best Happy Hour near Pacific Beach' list.
gaps.fix: Build /happy-hour with days and times (daily 3–6 PM), named small plates with prices, drink specials, and the Garnet Ave / Pacific Beach location. Say 'tapas-style small plates' explicitly and add a cheap-eats angle for q12. Put 'Happy Hour 3–6 PM' in the title and meta description. Add the same details to the Google Business Profile, Yelp and OpenTable, and get on Yelp's happy-hour lists.

gaps.gap: Only 2 crawlable pages and no Restaurant, Menu, FAQ or rating schema
gaps.evidence: pages_found: ['/', '/about']. Schema types are only Organization, WebSite, WebPage, BreadcrumbList and similar. has_restaurant_schema, has_faq, has_menu_schema and has_rating_schema are all false. The title ('Authentic Greek and Mediterranean Food - Cafe Athena') has no location. The meta description does not mention happy hour, vegan/GF, events, cocktails or 1990. Café Athena's 4.5 Google rating (498 reviews) and 4.2 Yelp rating are not marked up.
gaps.competitor_example: JRDN's site has 9 pages (/menu, /faq, /events, /private-events, /catering, /happy-hour and others), FAQPage schema and 5,181 words versus Café Athena's 1,566. It wins q18 and q24. Caveat: Costa Brava also has no Restaurant schema and Meze, Spitz and Pueblo blocked the crawler (403), yet all still win. Site structure is therefore a necessary hygiene fix, not the main driver of those wins.
gaps.fix: Add Restaurant (servesCuisine: Greek, Mediterranean; hasMenu; openingHours; foundingDate 1990; aggregateRating; acceptsReservations) with FAQPage and Menu schema. Create the dedicated pages in gaps 1, 2 and 4. Rewrite the title as 'Café Athena | Greek & Mediterranean Restaurant, Bar & Happy Hour in Pacific Beach, San Diego'.

gaps.gap: No group-dining, private-event or catering presence (0 of 10 answers)
gaps.evidence: Group_events: 0 of 8 answers. Catering: 0 of 2 answers. Lost queries q05, q13, q14, q15 and q16. The site signals private_events and catering are true, but there is no /private-events, /catering or /events page (JRDN has all three). Café Athena is not on Tagvenue (4 citations) or Peerspace (6 citations), and its directories list has no event marketplace.
gaps.competitor_example: Meze is on Tagvenue. Sifnos Greek Catering, Georgia's Greek Cuisine and Olympic Cafe win Greek catering (q15). pitahousesd.com (11 citations) and shawarmahousesd.com (4) are competitors' own domains cited for catering. flamingodeck.com (5 citations) is cited for large-group queries. Café Athena has no equivalent page for AI to cite.
gaps.fix: Create /private-events (capacity, rehearsal-dinner and birthday packages, set menus, inquiry form) and /catering (office-lunch Mediterranean trays, Greek catering, minimums, delivery area). Use the exact phrases from q05, q14, q15 and q16. Add FAQ schema. List the venue on Tagvenue and Peerspace, and submit it to Sandi Spots and sandiegorestaurants.com.

gaps.gap: Absent from the niche directories and local lists that AI assistants cite
gaps.evidence: Cited sources: yelp.com 95, tripadvisor.com 29, opentable.com 21, findmeglutenfree.com 11, atly.com 9, sandispots.com 6, sandiegorestaurants.com 6, peerspace.com 6, tagvenue.com 4, getgreece.com 3. Café Athena's directories list shows only OpenTable, Toast Local, DoorDash, Postmates and MenuPages. Yelp alone is about 44% of the top-15 citations (95 of 217). recent_press is empty and reddit_mentions is null.
gaps.competitor_example: Meze appears on Sandi Spots (#2 of 3 Best Greek, 85/100), GetGreece (Top 10 Greek Restaurants), Tripadvisor (#1 Greek), findmeglutenfree, HappyCow and Tagvenue, covering most of the sources AI cites. Pueblo lists 11 directories and JRDN lists 12.
gaps.fix: Claim and complete Yelp, Tripadvisor, Google Business Profile and OpenTable with the same copy (happy hour, vegan/GF, events, cocktails, since 1990). Add findmeglutenfree, HappyCow, Tagvenue, Peerspace, Restaurant Guru and Foursquare. Pitch Sandi Spots, GetGreece, sandiegorestaurants.com and atly.com for Greek and Pacific Beach roundups.

gaps.gap: Mythology cocktails, date-night and 'long-running local' positioning are invisible
gaps.evidence: Occasion: 1 of 7 answers (14%, sov_rank 52). Lost queries: q06, q19, q24, q25, q27. q30 (long-running PB restaurants, broad category) is also lost. Café Athena's known_for does not mention the cocktails at all. The site's 'cocktails' signal is only a generic true. There is no cocktail menu page or schema and no press on the mythology theme. 'Heritage' is true on the site, but the 1990 date is not in structured data.
gaps.competitor_example: q27 (unique cocktails) goes to Realm of the 52 Remedies, Common Theory and False Idol, which are known for their cocktails. q06 goes to Bar Ella and The Grass Skirt. q30 goes to Mr. Frostie, World Famous and Nite Owl, which are known as long-running places. JRDN wins q24 and q18 on views and atmosphere, with FOX 5, TravelAwaits and Sandi Spots coverage.
gaps.fix: Publish /cocktails with each Greek-mythology drink named and described (ingredients, the myth behind it). Add a 'Since 1990, family-owned in Pacific Beach' story to the About page and schema. Add pages or sections for date night, anniversary and family dining that use the query wording. Pitch the cocktail program to local drink and bar roundups.

gaps.gap: Review volume is 3–8x smaller than the competitors who win
gaps.evidence: Café Athena: Google 498, Yelp 890, Tripadvisor 101. Meze: Google 2,514 (5x), Yelp 3,442 (3.9x), Tripadvisor 767 (7.6x). Costa Brava: Google 1,768 (3.6x), Yelp 2,798 (3.1x), Tripadvisor 257. JRDN: Google 1,531, Yelp 1,820, Tripadvisor 576. Pueblo: Google 1,156, Yelp 1,563. Ratings are comparable (Google 4.5 vs 4.3–4.6; Yelp 4.2 vs 3.9–4.4), so the gap is volume, not quality. Yelp is the #1 cited source. Mention rate when listed is 25%, but top3_rate is only 8.3% and avg_position is 5.07.
gaps.competitor_example: Meze's 4.4 across all three platforms on 6,700+ combined reviews, and its #1 Tripadvisor Greek ranking, make it the default Greek answer. It wins position 2.8 on average versus Café Athena's 5.07. Even JRDN, with a 3.9 Yelp rating, ranks on review volume.
gaps.fix: Run a steady review program: QR codes on tables and checks, a post-visit text or email link, and a staff script. Prioritize Yelp and Tripadvisor (101 reviews is the weakest spot), then Google. Ask for reviews that name dishes, happy hour and dietary options, since AI assistants quote review language. Respond to every review.

gaps.gap: Greek-authority credentials are old, and rivals have fresh 2025–2026 coverage
gaps.evidence: Café Athena's best-of lists run 2006–2009, 2014, 2016 and a 2021 runner-up, with no listing newer than 2021 and recent_press empty. q02 ('best Greek restaurant in San Diego') is a 100% miss, as is q31 (best Mediterranean near La Jolla). q20 (best lamb dish) and q29 (hummus and pita near Mission Bay) are also lost, even though dish mentions are 71%. Dish top3_rate is 0%.
gaps.competitor_example: Meze has San Diego Magazine Best of 2025 (unverified at source), Sandi Spots 2026, GetGreece 2026, San Diego Explorer 2026 and a Tripadvisor #1 Greek ranking. It is also named on q02 along with Olympic Cafe and Athens Market Taverna. Spitz has 2025–2026 press (Hoodline, SanDiegoVille).
gaps.fix: Pitch a fresh angle ('35 years, family-owned, 2019 renovation, mythology cocktails') to San Diego Magazine, Eater San Diego, Hoodline and SanDiegoVille. Get on Sandi Spots and GetGreece. Add dish pages or sections for lamb, hummus and pita, gyros plate and avgolemono so AI can answer dish queries. Add 'serving Mission Beach, Mission Bay and La Jolla visitors' content.
